subject: Invoice publisher & notification routing for Horizon Health
messages:
From: Claire Thompson <ap@horizonhealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: ap-team@horizonhealth.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Who publishes Redwood invoices and where should copies be sent?

Hi Ben,

We are updating our AP intake rules and need to confirm a couple items before we enable automatic processing:

- Who at Redwood is considered the invoice publisher (the 'From' on the invoice payload)?
- Can Redwood publish invoices to our portal (inbound SFTP/API) AND also send an email copy to ap-team@horizonhealth.com? If yes, which should be considered primary?
- We need a sample invoice file and an XML schema for mapping prior to configuring our system.

Would be great to confirm by EOD Monday so we can schedule the mapping work.

Thanks,
Claire Thompson
Accounts Payable Lead
Horizon Health
ap@horizonhealth.com

Attachment: invoice-schema-req.txt (TXT)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Claire Thompson <ap@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who publishes Redwood invoices and where should copies be sent?

Hi Claire — thanks for the quick note. Short answers up front:

1) Publisher: Redwood Finance (invoices will show issuer as "Redwood Inference, Inc.").
2) Delivery: We can publish to your portal (SFTP or API) and also send a PDF copy by email to ap-team@horizonhealth.com. Typically customers pick portal as the canonical source and email as a backup/notification.
3) I attached a representative PDF and an XML schema example to help your mapping team.

If you prefer, we can have our onboarding engineer (Connor) coordinate the SFTP credentials exchange and a short mapping call. Proposed next steps:
- You confirm preferred portal endpoint (SFTP or API) and sample file naming convention.
- We schedule a 30-min mapping call this week to validate fields.
- Once mapping is accepted we'll route future invoices to portal as primary and CC ap-team@horizonhealth.com.

If Horizon wants email-first (no portal), we can flip to email-only but it increases manual handling risk for high volume.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: sample-invoice-Redwood-202705.pdf (PDF), invoice-schema-example.xml (XML)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Who publishes Redwood invoices and where should copies be sent?

Thanks Ben + Claire — looping in details from our side. A couple operational notes to help Horizon's mapping team: 

- Canonical filename we emit: REDWOOD_INV_{customer_id}_{YYYYMM}.pdf and REDWOOD_INV_{customer_id}_{YYYYMM}.xml for structured payloads.
- The portal/API integration supports daily and monthly emit windows; please confirm cutoff preference (we default to end-of-day UTC).
- When portal is primary, our upstream system writes an audit header (x-invoice-origin: REDWOOD_FINANCE) so your AP system can auto-ingest and suppress duplicates from emailed copies.
- For email copies we recommend sending to a single address (ap-team@horizonhealth.com) rather than a distribution list to avoid mailbox rules firing twice.

Claire — would you like Connor to send an SFTP test drop this afternoon and a short SFTP credentials checklist? If so, send me the host/user whitelisting details and we'll proceed.

Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
